import sys, json, codecs, unicodedata
cases=json.load(sys.stdin)
assert sys.version_info[:3] == (3,14,7)
assert unicodedata.unidata_version == '16.0.0'
results=[]
for c in cases:
 try:
  v,n,o=getattr(codecs,'utf_'+str(c['width'])+'_ex_decode')(bytes(c['input']),c['errors'],c['order'],c['final'])
  results.append({'result':[list(map(ord,v)),n,o]})
 except UnicodeDecodeError as e:
  results.append({'error':[e.encoding,e.start,e.end,e.reason], 'initial':[e.args[2],e.args[3],e.args[4]]})
print(json.dumps({'oracle':{'version':sys.version,'unicode':unicodedata.unidata_version,'platform':sys.platform,'byteorder':sys.byteorder},'results':results}))
